title: Buying his first cornet
summary: He bought a Conn cornet, probably on Canal Street.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the horn: first instrument and the trombone

blocks.x: Okay, it's going again. There's a couple more things I was going to ask about. Way back in the beginning, when you started on Barnett, what kind of an instrument did you get? And where did you get it?

Well, I got a, a Korn instrument. A Korn. G.W. Korn, I think, was the proper initial. I think it's G.W. Korn. And where'd you buy it? I may be mistaken, but it was a Korn instrument. C-O-N-N. Yeah, C.G. Korn. C.G. Well, let's not see. Where'd you get, where'd you buy it? I got that from, well, I think it was.
On Canal Street. Yes, sir. Did your father encourage you to take it up? How come you wanted to take up Korn? Did you like music when you were a boy? Did you hear any bands? I did, yes, sir, I did.
